en.text:
Grants 20 Stability, 60 Reload Speed, and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration.

Hipfired shots apply 10 <solar/>Scorch stacks (15 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) on hit with a 0.5 second cooldown.

Kills while ADS trigger a <solar/>Solar explosion that applies 30 <solar/>Scorch stacks (40 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) to enemies within an 8 meter radius.
